td.p: Start the local POC with one command, select one user/threat story, draw the boundary, define the smallest middleware data contract, and complete the backend happy path.
A real local Agent Run reaches your new middleware code and produces one inspectable decision/event.
Finish enforcement or instrumentation, add the minimum UI, and implement the negative/failure scenario.
Positive and negative cases both work without manually editing data during the demo.
Add tests, harden errors and cleanup, verify deployment, finish the one-page architecture, and rehearse the three-minute demo.
A teammate can deploy from the README and deliver the demo within three minutes.

callout.p: If your team is still changing frameworks or cloud topology late on Day 1, return to the Starter Kit baseline and narrow the middleware story.
